turns.question: How much of our campaigns' budget was left at the end of September 2026?
turns.answer: EUR 4,130 of campaign budget was left at the end of September 2026 (the month-end snapshot for 1 to 30 September 2026). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
